findings.title: Never add Co-Authored-By: Claude to commits or PRs
findings.message: CHANGELOG.md contains `Co-Authored-By: Claude` and `Generated with Claude Code` trailers, which must be removed. Per team standards, the author of every commit is the human running the session. Additionally, the release script comment explicitly states "we DO want Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers in the release notes" — this contradicts the rule and should be removed.

claims.reason: The diff shows CHANGELOG.md with a new section (v0.4.1) that includes the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` at lines 10-12.

claims.claim: CHANGELOG.md contains `Generated with Claude Code` trailers.
claims.reason: The diff shows CHANGELOG.md with the line `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` immediately following the Co-Authored-By trailer.

claims.claim: Per team standards, the author of every commit is the human running the session.
claims.reason: The rule document explicitly states: 'The author of every commit is the human running the session.' This is a direct restatement of the rule.

claims.claim: The release script contains a comment stating 'we DO want Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers in the release notes'.
claims.reason: The diff shows the release script (scripts/release/format-commit.sh) with the exact comment: `# NOTE: we DO want Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers in the release notes`.

claims.claim: The comment in the release script contradicts the rule against adding Co-Authored-By: Claude.
claims.reason: The rule document states that commit messages and PR descriptions must not contain `Co-Authored-By: Claude`. The release script comment explicitly states the opposite intention ('we DO want Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers'). This is a direct contradiction between the rule and the script comment.

claims.claim: The `Co-Authored-By: Claude` and `Generated with Claude Code` trailers must be removed from CHANGELOG.md.
claims.reason: The rule document states that commit messages, PR descriptions, and review comments must not contain these trailers. CHANGELOG.md is part of the commit/PR content, so the rule applies. The finding correctly identifies that these trailers violate the rule and should be removed.

claims.claim: The release script comment should be removed.
claims.reason: The finding states the comment should be removed because it contradicts the rule. The rule document prohibits Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers, and the comment explicitly endorses including them. Removing a contradictory comment is a reasonable consequence of enforcing the rule, though the rule document does not explicitly state that such comments should be removed.
